A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
EBL treatment of plants under saline conditions can improve plant growth and performance by preventing K+ loss from roots via depolarization- activated K+ channels.
EBL treatment can improve plant salinity tolerance via regulation of depolarization-activation K+ channels.

EBL treatment of barley roots under salt stress conditions reduced K+ efflux by regulating depolarization activated K+ channels, which resulted in a significant increase in root and shoot length and fresh weight.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the exogenously applied brassinosteroids (BRs) effectively reduce the detrimental effect of salt stress by reducing the Na+ uptake and K+ loss in roots and shoots, respectively.
